_comment: AgriPulse India location catalog. Canonical, reusable State/UT > District > Mandi/APMC reference for the monitored districts. Every district is a REAL administrative district and every code below is either an ISO 3166-2:IN state code or an LGD (Local Government Directory) district code -- nothing is invented. Mandi/APMC NAMES are carried from the factual reference that anchors weather pulls; mandi/APMC CODES are deliberately omitted until they are verified against an official e-NAM / AGMARKNET mandi master. Coordinates are approximate district/mandi reference coordinates (public geographic reference) used as weather-API anchors; production should refine them against an official gazetteer / boundary service.

_meta.state_code_note: 2-letter ISO state/UT codes used throughout the pipeline (MH, PB, UP, HR, MP, GJ, TN, TS, KA, WB).
_meta.district_code_standard: LGD district code (Local Government Directory, Ministry of Panchayati Raj, Government of India)
_meta.district_code_note: Current LGD numbering as published on the Open Government Data (OGD) 'District LGD codes' resource, cross-checked against LGDirectory references. Example: Coimbatore LGD 569 (confirmed via LGDirectory entry on Wikidata, 2026); older state-portal copies that still list Coimbatore as 523 use a superseded numbering and are NOT used here.
_meta.mandi_code_note: No mandi/APMC code is assigned to any record: an official e-NAM / AGMARKNET mandi master has not been verified, and this catalog never invents codes. The `mandi` and `apmc` fields carry factual market names only.

sources.name: Local Government Directory (LGD), Government of India
sources.note: Authoritative directory of districts and their codes. Land-region hierarchy: State/UT > District > Sub-district > Village.

sources.name: Open Government Data (data.gov.in) -- District LGD codes resource
sources.note: CSV of 766 district records with LGD codes plus census 2001/2011 district codes as cross-reference; monthly refresh of the LGD master. Source of the district_code values in this catalog.

sources.name: LGDirectory reference for Coimbatore district (LGD 569)
sources.note: Independent cross-check that the current LGD district code for Coimbatore is 569 (older portal copies listing 523 use a superseded numbering).

sources.name: ISO 3166-2:IN state/UT codes
sources.note: Standard 2-letter state/UT codes used for state_code.

sources.name: Existing factual monitored-district reference (mandi/APMC names)
sources.note: Carried the factual mandi/APMC names used as weather-API anchors; superseded by this canonical catalog.

notes: region_name is the monitoring label used by the pipeline's weather/gold partition keys. It equals the district name for most records and differs only where the label is a well-known city alias of a named district: Kanpur Nagar -> 'Kanpur', Ranga Reddy -> 'Hyderabad', Bengaluru Urban -> 'Bengaluru'.
Coordinates remain approximate district/mandi anchors for the Open-Meteo pull (see data_catalog 'geography-india-reference').
